description: This file defines an abstract class 'ComparisonNode' in Java, representing a generic comparison operation node used in an abstract syntax tree (AST) for a query or predicate language. It includes properties for comparison type, property, and value, along with relevant methods for access and object identity.

classes.name: ComparisonNode
classes.description: An abstract class representing a comparison node with a type, property, and value, used in predicate evaluation.

methods.name: ComparisonNode
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a comparison node with type, property, and value.

methods.name: getComparisonProperty
methods.description: Returns the property involved in the comparison.

methods.name: getComparisonValue
methods.description: Returns the value used in the comparison.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a predicate visitor to perform operations based on the node type.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the comparison node.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for the node based on its properties.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on properties.
